scripts.dev:raw: cd ../.. && bun run build:web && cd apps/electron && bun run build && electron . --verbose
scripts.dev: if command -v nix >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -z "$IN_NIX_SHELL" ]; then nix develop --command bun run dev:raw; else bun run dev:raw; fi
scripts.start: if command -v nix >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -z "$IN_NIX_SHELL" ]; then nix develop --command bun run start:raw; else bun run start:raw; fi
scripts.package:raw: cd ../.. && bun run build:web && cd apps/electron && bun run build && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.package: if command -v nix >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -z "$IN_NIX_SHELL" ]; then nix develop --command bun run package:raw; else bun run package:raw; fi
scripts.package:linux:raw: cd ../.. && bun run build:web && cd apps/electron && bun run build && electron-builder --linux --publish never
scripts.package:linux: if command -v nix >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -z "$IN_NIX_SHELL" ]; then nix develop --command bun run package:linux:raw; else bun run package:linux:raw; fi
scripts.package:windows:raw: cd ../.. && bun run build:web && cd apps/electron && bun run build && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.package:windows: if command -v nix >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -z "$IN_NIX_SHELL" ]; then nix develop --command bun run package:windows:raw; else bun run package:windows:raw; fi
scripts.validate:raw: bun run build && bun run package:linux:raw
scripts.validate: if command -v nix >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -z "$IN_NIX_SHELL" ]; then nix develop --command bun run validate:raw; else bun run validate:raw; fi
